villageLost.beat: Haven couldn't hold. On the fifth hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

deathDayLines.line: — DAY 18 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

🔥 Abigail has been turning something over all evening. Finally: “Terrence. The past story — we all eat from the same pot here, we don’t get to lie about who’s at it.” It costs Abigail to say it; you can see the price land.

Terrence is quiet for a long moment. Then, all in a rush: “Fine. It’s true. Not Denver — Columbus, Ohio. I lied because the truth felt small.” The admission hangs there, and the village — to its credit — doesn’t pounce.
People bring you their suspicions, written down. You keep every one.
Eric Melnyk reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 401 kcal conserved. By the fire. Good enough.)
You chew the bitter leaves. Folk say it helps — you wouldn't know. (+2 health, maybe)
You eat Blackberry (520 kcal).
Took Dried beans.
You eat Dried beans (150 kcal).
Took Dried beans.
You eat Dried beans (150 kcal).
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Eric — 💧 Fetch water. Eric nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
🌱 Stan waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 Stan checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~21 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 Stan pries 2 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (21 stone now.)

Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
📋 Eric — 💧 Fetch water. Eric nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Abigail doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
Abigail waits until the fire's lit and people are watching. Then, loud enough for all of them: "Who put YOU in charge?"

💧 Abigail returns with 9L, but the cistern only holds 0L more.

You catch fragments by the fire — Ruby telling Rafael about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
💧 Pāora returns with water: +2 clean.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
The fire burns lower than it should. Nobody wants to be the one to go for wood in the dark.
The relief moment passes — the crisis runs its own course now. What you did stands; what you didn't, doesn't.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
💛 You hold Father's Whetstone. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)

💛 You hold Photo Album. Faces from before. Nancy's wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
Travel 1 tile to meadow.
You catch fragments by the fire — Abigail telling Theo about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — Hassan telling Theo about himself. The retelling is already better than the event.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to grove.

While you were gone — one thing you missed:
⚔️ Hassan stood down the Anaconda Empress and kept walking — 7 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.

Theo leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Glasswing Darter. Move when the shadow grows. Watch the shadow, not the bug — when it grows, the dive is coming. MOVE while it falls and it lands on dirt. A missed dive grounds it: that's your window."

The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
They come fast and scared — a family, or what's left of one. "Please. We heard you take people in." Behind them, something worse than weather.
It's settled. The village is calling it "The Big Beast." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+4 integration)
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "We have studied cooking. Step one: apply heat until food stops being food? No — wait. We had it. Teach us? Show us one cooked meal, start to finish."
📺 SYSTEM: "We have already cleared your morning. You are welcome. We require 300 kcal of tubers and your full attention. The fans love a cooking segment."
You lay out 325 kcal of tubers and roots, build the fire up, and start. The System watches with the intensity of a trillion eyes.
📝 SYSTEM NOTE: "Heat applied. Food is now HOT. Hypothesis: hot food is better because it is hot. ...We will allow it."
📝 SYSTEM NOTE: "You stopped BEFORE it stopped being food. Restraint. We did not know restraint was a flavor. Logging it as one."
📝 SYSTEM NOTE: "The tubers did not scream. Our models predicted screaming. The models have been updated. You are welcome."
🍲 It replicates your stew for the whole haven. It added a garnish of pocket lint. It's still 400 kcal. You eat around the lint. (+400 kcal to the pantry. The System is SO proud.)
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
Village meal: +1000 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🔍 Theo has been turning over a knee-high weed with soft green leaves and a seedy spike for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
Theo traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Rafael is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
◈ CRISIS — THE FIRST GRAVE. Rafael is dead. The village digs its first grave, and everyone understands at once: this place can kill you. It just did.
SYSTEM: "Oh. Oh no. Was that supposed to happen? The audience is crying. I did not know they could do that."
📖 The entry for Rafael is finished. 4 deeds recorded. No more pages.
RAFAEL — GONE. 1 open question closed unanswered.
💀 Rafael starved. Slowly. Nobody eats much tonight. The pot stays full and nobody touches it.
